notes:
**Manuscript v0.8.25 highlights:**

- The journal chip says which limit is near
- Each word count in the status bar is coloured by its own limit
- The Word Count window reads in words
- Journal Profile asks before deleting or clearing a profile
- A first export is offered beside the project
- Accept All and Reject All say how much they will change
- Review windows show dates, kinds and counts in plain words
- Removing a reference's PDF asks first
- Preferences offers "Check spelling as you type"
- Shortcuts are written for your computer
- Error messages say what failed
- Shortened lists say so
- One arrow for menu paths
- Plainer words in messages
- Rejecting a section's changes and restoring heading defaults no longer default to Yes
- "Cancelled" is spelled one way throughout
- Submission Readiness lists what the profile checks
- A requirement that could not be checked is reported
- The package report leads with missing tables
- Import Reviewed DOCX keeps what you must check on screen
- Retraction check says what it could not check
- Restore Current Section names the section and asks first
- The "most of this section was removed" prompt is clearer and cannot be answered by accident
- Checks counts fewer false alarms
- To-dos and Comments count unlinked items
- The Refs chip offers choices instead of acting
- The Track chip says what its number is
- Journal and funder chips read correctly at every count
- The selection count is written out
- Status-bar colours are readable
- Status-bar messages are no longer cut off
- Recent Messages keeps every status-bar message for the session
- Notices that need your attention stay on screen
- A body word limit with no sections to count is no longer silent
- Discard on close discards everything
- Replacing a section with generated text keeps the old text
- Preferences → Default editor mode switches the open editors
- A damaged project part is reported once, in plain words
- A blinded copy is checked before it is written
- A required journal summary must be within its limits
- Journal Profile: example text no longer reads as a rule, and entries are not dropped
- "Journal profile applied." keeps the notice that the citation style was not applied
- Import Reviewed DOCX: Import works with only footnote edits ticked
- Funder Profile: a limit with a unit and no maximum is no longer dropped on Apply
- Track Changes review no longer says there is nothing to review while other changes are pending
- Double-clicking a project in Finder opens it
- A project opened from Finder no longer loads underneath an open dialog
- A required-text rule can contain "|"
- Autosave no longer says "Autosaved" when part of the project failed to save
- "Save Failed" says what happened to your work
- The running-title counter uses the attached journal's limit
- Journal Summaries says "over the limit" in words
- Add Reference accepts years before 1900
- Esc in the Collaborators window keeps your edits
- The response-letter export keeps its warning on screen
- Getting Started is readable in the dark theme
- Messages no longer point to menus that do not exist
- Version History no longer says a version "matches" when sections were renamed, reordered or reformatted
- The figure editor asks before discarding your changes
- The Words figure and Submission Readiness agree on the body count
- Spell-check messages no longer tell you to install a software package
